trigger: Final complete98/all3arms prediction seal AND POSTSEAL_SCORING exist and validate before metric reads

cluster_interval.method: Exact ordered session resampling with replacement
cluster_interval.weights: Each draw duplicates all paired frames of each sampled session; report frame-weighted mean
cluster_interval.scope: Exploratory interval from four reused sessions; no external generalization or significance claim

case_addition: All original-success to final-failure primary cases; both CAL and TEST
OT_activity_scope: Selected accepted pose only; inequalities normalized by frozen solver

attribution.NO_PRIOR_vs_ORIGINAL: Compound B/I correction/state/soft fitting/search/OT; not isolated BI effect
attribution.BASE_V4_vs_NO_PRIOR: Zero-mean prior effect conditional on same observations
attribution.FINAL_vs_BASE_V4: CAL median bias effect conditional on verified fresh-observation parity
attribution.FINAL_vs_NO_OT: All OT constraints effect with same frozen measurements/calibrated covariance/prior/bias
attribution.MEAN_ONLY_vs_ORIGINAL: CAL global mean shift without B/I fit or O/T
attribution.FINAL_vs_MEAN_ONLY: Statewise fit/constraints relative to mean-only baseline; not isolated component

target_failure_policy: If any fixed target fails, report target_achieved false; hypotheses only, no new TEST tuning
limitations: Native-incompatible and fallback frames remain included
CAL full-model audit is not the conditional LOGO selection score
Initial S is geometry-conditional, so human SELF disagreements are diagnosed separately
Accepted ambiguous pose families do not prove unique pose or exact O/T coordinates
